home.problem.intro.defaultMessage: Indian neighbourhood shops already stock what people need. But running the counter, the stock and the customers by hand leaves money on the shelf.

home.problem.1.title.defaultMessage: Stock is hard to keep track of

home.problem.1.body.defaultMessage: Items get missed and counts drift, so it is hard to know what is selling.

home.problem.2.title.defaultMessage: People nearby do not know you have it

home.problem.2.body.defaultMessage: Someone may need an item that is on your shelf, a few minutes away, and never find out.

home.problem.3.body.defaultMessage: Without a view of demand it is easy to overstock the wrong things.

home.problem.4.title.defaultMessage: You cannot see what people want

home.problem.4.body.defaultMessage: Shops rarely know what people around them are searching for.

home.features.title.defaultMessage: A simple way to grow your shop

home.features.intro.defaultMessage: One app for the counter, the stock and the customers. Built for everyday shop work, in your language.

home.features.1.body.defaultMessage: Bill at the counter, keep stock up to date and see your customers in one app. It keeps working when the internet drops.

home.features.2.body.defaultMessage: Shoppers find your stock, book it, and pick it up or ask for delivery.

home.features.3.body.defaultMessage: Every sale updates your stock, and shoppers see how fresh it is before they come.

home.features.4.body.defaultMessage: Offers and credits give people a reason to come to your shop again.

home.faq.intro.defaultMessage: Something else on your mind? Leave your details below and the TodayZ team will get in touch.

home.faq.1.a.defaultMessage: TodayZ is free for shops for now. See the pricing page for the latest.

home.faq.2.q.defaultMessage: Do I need to be good with phones?

home.faq.2.a.defaultMessage: No. The business app is built for everyday shop work, and you can start with a few items.

home.faq.3.q.defaultMessage: How do shoppers get their items?

home.faq.3.a.defaultMessage: They book the item on TodayZ, then pick it up from your shop or ask for delivery.

home.faq.4.a.defaultMessage: Any neighbourhood shop that sells physical goods, from grocery to hardware.
